release_gates.resolution: Maintainer explicitly accepts preserving mixed BSD/AGPL source scope, bundling no dependency implementations/images/binaries, and documenting that combined-distribution obligations need review before deployment or bundling. This resolves the experimental artifact scope, not the legal status of unreviewed future combinations.

release_gates.question: Review service targets, MFA/TLS, logs/IP/privacy, retention, delivery and private reporting route.
release_gates.resolution: Experimental source scope keeps runtime opt-in disabled by default and documents unresolved installation policy. Maintainer selected GitHub private vulnerability reporting, to be activated and verified only after final publication approval and before the first source push. Activation is a remaining publication prerequisite, not a completed check.

release_gates.question: Run PHP lint and PHP/HTTP tests, including both public-form opt-in states.
release_gates.resolution: PHP 8.3.36 with host INI disabled: all 30 PHP files linted; 29 closure and 26 concurrency-outcome PHP mock cases passed; 17 real PHP/HTTP/SMTP loopback fixture tests passed with zero skips/failures. Full service/framework/FPM/TLS compatibility remains in SERVICE-VALIDATION.
